app "ball" ball ocean

setting overs num = 20
let legal = count(ball today where wide = no)
let runs = sum(ball.runs today) + count(ball today where wide = yes)
let wkts = count(ball today where out = yes)
runs "/" wkts big
"Overs" floor(legal / 6) + legal % 6 / 10 "of" overs ". Run rate" round(runs * 6 / legal) faint
row gap 1
  each [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 6]
    button it tap add ball runs = it

  button "Wide" tap add ball wide = yes
  button "Out" fill bad tap add ball out = yes
  button "Undo" tap remove last(ball today)
row gap 1
  each ball today sort at desc top 6
    draw width 36
      circle 50, 50, 46 fill if(it.out, bad, if(it.runs >= 4, good, soft))
      if it.out
        label 50, 50, "W" bold
      else
        label 50, 50, it.runs bold

let b = 360 * (((wake - 0:00) / 1h) % 12) / 12
draw width 220
  circle 50, 50, 46 stroke edge thick 1
  arc 50, 50, 38, a, if(b > a, b, b + 360) stroke accent thick 6
  label 50, 8, "12" tiny
  label 92, 52, "3" tiny
  label 50, 96, "6" tiny
  label 8, 52, "9" tiny
  label 50, 50, ((wake - bed) / 1h + 24) % 24 big
"Bedtime" bed "Wake-up" wake head

app "Wedding" gift ink
table guest name text, side pick Bride|Groom = Bride, rsvp pick Waiting|Yes|No = Waiting, seat num 0.. = 0 "Table number"
table gift guest ref guest, item text
table thanks guest ref guest, sent bool
screen guests "Guests" users
  count(guest where rsvp = Yes) "coming," count(guest where rsvp = Waiting) "waiting" head
  each guest sort name as g
    row card tap edit g swipe remove g
      g.name bold grow
      g.rsvp color if(g.rsvp = Yes, good, if(g.rsvp = No, bad, muted))
  form guest, "Add guest"
screen tables "Seating" seat
  grid 2 gap 1
    each 1..10 as n
      stack card gap 0
        "Table" n bold
        count(guest where seat = n) "guests" faint
        each guest where seat = n as g
          g.name small
screen gifts "Gifts" gift
  list gift
  form gift, "Add gift"
screen notes "Thank you" note
  each guest where rsvp = Yes as g
    row card
      toggle g.thanks
      g.name grow
  form thanks, "Add thank-you note"
